title: r1 fix didn't bite client-side: fixture still names adverse-story applicant 'Grace Kelly' (famous real person); only the email was swapped to grainne.foley@
evidence: const app_grace_json = "{\"id\":\"a-grace\",...,\"first_name\":\"Grace\",\"last_name\":\"Kelly\",\"email\":\"grainne.foley@example.ie\",...,\"has_eviction_history\":true,\"eviction_details\":\"Rent arrears, possession order settled in 2024\",\"has_ccjs\":true,...,\"status\":\"rejected\",...}" ; client/src/demo/demo_store.gleam:1435: #("a-grace", "RightTenantry-Report-Grace-Kelly.pdf"), ; server/src/demo/pdf_prebake.gleam:424: applicant_name: "Gráinne Foley", (pdftotext report-a-grace.pdf shows 'Gráinne Foley')
detail: The rename landed only in pdf_prebake/PDFs. The SPA leaderboard, applicant detail, and download filename still show 'Grace Kelly' — a famous real person — attached to fabricated eviction, CCJ, and rejection data on the ungated public demo. UI/PDF names also now mismatch.
recommended_fix: Rename the client fixture to 'Gráinne'/'Foley' (matching the PDFs) and update demo_store.report_filenames to RightTenantry-Report-Grainne-Foley.pdf.

title: Response-race paths can issue real network calls from demo mode: policy-gate wrapper check_session and ApiReturnedConsentCheck(Ok(True)) create_checkout
evidence: client.gleam:291-297 (update/2 wrapper, no demo_mode check): True -> #( next_model, effect.batch([next_effect, auth_api.check_session(ApiReturnedSession)]), ) ; client.gleam:477: ApiReturnedNotificationsRefresh(Error(e)) -> check(e) ; client.gleam:3712-3722: msg.ApiReturnedConsentCheck(vid, Ok(True)) -> case model.checkout_loading { Some(current) if current == vid -> #( model, payment_api.create_checkout( vacancy_id: vid,
detail: A logged-in landlord entering demo with a real request in flight (poll GET 428, or check_consent Ok(True)) triggers real calls from demo mode: an authenticated /me GET, or a create_checkout POST (CSRF-blocked by the demo token). Pillar demands totality.
recommended_fix: Gate the policy-gate wrapper on !next_model.demo_mode, and demo-guard (or intercept) ApiReturnedConsentCheck in demo_update like other payment arms.

title: Latent real write: UserAcceptedPolicy fires auth_api.accept_policy in demo if policy version ever exceeds fixture's pinned '2026-05-23'; conformance test pins a literal, not policy_highlights.version
evidence: fixtures_conformance_test.gleam:23-25: // accepted_policy_version must match the current server policy version or // the re-acceptance modal would fire inside the demo. landlord.accepted_policy_version |> should.equal("2026-05-23") ; shared/src/shared/policy_highlights.gleam: pub const version: String = "2026-05-23" ; client.gleam:1366-1368: auth_api.accept_policy( version: model.server_policy_version, csrf_token: model.csrf_token,
detail: Unreachable today (versions equal), but a future policy bump that forgets the fixture keeps the test green, opens the re-acceptance modal in demo, and accept fires a real POST with 'demo-csrf-token'. The lint exemption 'demo mode is always False here' then breaks silently.
recommended_fix: Pin the test against policy_highlights.version instead of a literal, and intercept UserAcceptedPolicy in demo_update as defense-in-depth.

title: Carry-forward r1 #24 (unfixed): demo comparison selections and sweep-nudge dismissals still write to real web storage with no demo branch
evidence: client.gleam:3545-3547: let new_ids = list.append(ids, [id]) save_comparison_ids(new_ids) #(Model(..model, comparison_ids: new_ids), effect.none()) ; client.gleam:4940-4943: UserDismissedSweepNudge(application_id) -> { let updated_dismissed = set.insert(model.dismissed_sweep_nudges, application_id) save_dismissed_sweep_nudges(set.to_list(updated_dismissed))
detail: Demo-mode UI actions persist ids to sessionStorage/localStorage, contradicting the 'no persistence of any kind' scope guard. Only synthetic demo ids leak; r1 rated it a note and it remains unaddressed in the rework.
recommended_fix: Skip save_comparison_ids/save_dismissed_sweep_nudges (or use demo-scoped keys) when model.demo_mode is True.
